usage: Used for a workplace where office staff do desk-based work. Common in business, school administration, and government settings.
Very often appears with location words like 喺、去、返、入 to talk about going to or being in an office.
Can refer to either the room/building itself or an office department, depending on context.
Neutral and everyday; for a higher-level or formal style, people may use more specific terms like 部門 or 辦事處 in some contexts.
